hero.subtitle: We design, build and operate in-Kingdom GPU and AI platforms for regulated workloads, from facility and GPUs up to models, agents and 24x7 operations.

challenge.title: One partner rather than five vendors
challenge.body: A sovereign AI platform spans the facility, GPU compute, the data platform, MLOps, private models and the use cases themselves, with security and operations running through every layer. We design and integrate the whole stack, so you deal with one partner.
points: Regulated entities need dedicated, single-tenant capacity, air-gapped where required
SMEs, developers and universities need in-country GPU capacity with no upfront investment
Security and governance aligned with NCA ECC / CCC, PDPL and SDAIA AI Ethics
Operations embedded from the facility up, from day one

opportunity.title: We build it. We fill it. We run it.
opportunity.body: It is one AI factory architecture: we design the facility, power and cooling, build the GPU compute and network, deploy the sovereign AI and cloud platform with security and compliance built in, integrate operations from day one, and fill it with use cases and AI agents. The Saudi AI market is forecast to grow from USD 2.1B in 2025 to USD 16.9B in 2032.

capabilities.title: Use Cases & AI Agents
capabilities.body: Document intelligence, Arabic and English copilots, AI call center, analytics and decision support.

capabilities.title: Models & Inference
capabilities.body: Private open-weight LLMs (Arabic-capable), RAG, fine-tuning, inference serving and guardrails.

capabilities.title: MLOps & Orchestration
capabilities.body: Kubernetes, model registry and evaluation, pipelines, usage metering and cost governance.

capabilities.title: Sovereign Data Platform
capabilities.body: Ingestion, vector DB, feature store, data classification, and encryption at rest and in transit.

capabilities.title: GPU Compute & Storage
capabilities.body: GPU clusters, high-speed fabric and parallel storage, with capacity sized per workload.

capabilities.title: Facility & Hosting
capabilities.body: A dedicated AI factory in a client or sovereign facility, or an operator GPU cloud for GPUaaS / AIaaS.

capabilities.title: Security & Governance
capabilities.body: Zero-trust access and tenant isolation, GPU runtime security, and a blockchain-anchored audit trail and AI policy, across every layer.

capabilities.title: Managed GPU/AI Operations
capabilities.body: 24x7 NOC and SOC monitoring; AIOps for utilization, health and capacity; model performance and drift monitoring; SLA-backed L2/L3 support.

applications.title: Sovereign AI Factory
applications.body: Dedicated, single-tenant and in-Kingdom, for government and ministries, banking and financial services, defence and security, and energy, health and critical infrastructure.

applications.title: GPUaaS / AIaaS with an operator
applications.body: Shared, multi-tenant and sold as-a-service, for SMEs and start-ups, mid-market enterprises, software and AI developers, and universities and research.

applications.title: Private Arabic-capable LLMs
applications.body: Private LLMs, RAG and AI agents running on the client's own data.

applications.title: GPU-as-a-Service
applications.body: On-demand, in-country GPU capacity with no upfront investment.

applications.title: AI-as-a-Service
applications.body: Hosted models, inference APIs and ready AI apps, such as the AI Call Center, on the operator marketplace.

applications.title: Operations, run or handed over
applications.body: ADP-run 24x7 operations, or a structured handover to the client's team.

outcomes.label: Delivery phases, each ending with a decision gate and a tangible deliverable
First use cases taken to production in the onboarding phase
NOC and SOC monitoring under a managed GPU/AI service

vision2030.body: Security and governance run across every layer, aligned with NCA, PDPL and SDAIA's AI ethics principles, and the data and AI stay in the Kingdom in both delivery models.

deployment.note: A dedicated GPU cluster in the client's data center or a sovereign facility, air-gapped where required, or a multi-tenant GPU cloud implemented in a telecom or data center operator's facility.

extras.title: From strategy to a running platform in five phases
items: 1 · Assess & Strategize: use-case portfolio and value case, data classification and residency, regulatory mapping. Deliverable: AI strategy and prioritized roadmap
2 · Design & Size: target architecture, GPU sizing per workload, hosting model and security design. Deliverable: high-level and low-level design, BoQ
3 · Build & Integrate: infrastructure and platform deployment; IAM, SIEM and data-source integration; security hardening and testing. Deliverable: accepted, production-ready platform
4 · Onboard Use Cases: first 2–3 use cases to production, model evaluation and guardrails, user training and adoption. Deliverable: live use cases with measured outcomes
5 · Operate & Scale: managed GPU/AI service, capacity and cost governance, continuous compliance evidence. Deliverable: SLA-backed operations and growth plan
